title: Responsibilities, skills and criteria for choosing technology

videos.script: ana's first week on the data team, and Davi hands her a list that is not a list of tools. {{the-list}} It has the pipelines that run every night, and a promise about how fresh their data is. It has customers' personal data, and the law that covers it. And it has a monthly bill, and a phone that can ring at six in the morning. {{owns}} That is what the job is answerable for, and the tools come second. {{tools-second}} Then Marta needs a new report, and the team has to decide where its data will live. {{choice}} There are three reasonable answers, and a short program scores them. Change the weights, and the winner changes. {{matrix}} So the number is not the decision. The argument behind it is. {{argument}} And the argument gets written down, on one page, for whoever asks why in a year's time. {{record}} This lesson gives you the words for all of it: what the job owns, the skills it takes, and a way of choosing technology you can still defend later. {{end}}
